_comment: Manual AMC/BMO overrides for tickers when the price-action heuristic in pull_earnings.py is wrong or noisy. Keys are short tickers (without ' US Equity' suffix). Values: 'AMC' (after market close), 'BMO' (before market open), or 'DUR' (during market — treated as BMO). Add a ticker here when its computed d1/w1 doesn't match the actual reaction.
